description: Extract structured data from elements matching a CSS selector. No LLM needed — pure DOM extraction. Returns text (default), JSON (with tag, text, attrs, href, src), specific attributes, or clean list. Use for scraping tables, lists, links, form values. Limit: 100 elements for JSON, 200 for text.

format.description: Output format: 'text' (one per line), 'json' (full structure with attrs), 'list' (numbered)

selector.description: CSS selector to match elements (e.g. 'table tr', '.product', 'a')

name: browser_extract
